summary: Tested Bakers backend (13 pytest cases, 11 passed) and Expo web frontend. Backend endpoints (recipes, tips, categories, auth, favorites, upload) all work. AI chat endpoint returns 500 due to EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget exhausted. Frontend auth screen renders correctly with all required testIDs but successful login/register does NOT navigate to /(tabs) — user stays on /auth. This blocks all authenticated UI flows (home, recipes list interactions, assistant, share, profile) from being tested.

critical.issue: Returns 500 - litellm.BadRequestError: 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0'. Also model name 'claude-sonnet-5' may need verification (should likely be 'claude-sonnet-4-5' or similar valid identifier). EMERGENT_LLM_KEY appears to have zero budget.

minor.issue: Signature includes `user: Optional[dict] = None` which is unused/misleading (harmless but confusing).

ui_bugs.issue: After successful login/register (applyAuth sets user), the screen does NOT redirect to /(tabs). User remains on /auth screen. Need router.replace('/(tabs)') on success, or add <Redirect href='/(tabs)'/> when user becomes truthy.

integration_issues.issue: Blocked because auth screen does not redirect after successful auth. All downstream flows (home, recipes tab, assistant, share, profile, logout) could not be validated.

issues: Hero image, form and buttons render well on 390x844 viewport. Contrast and spacing look good.

action_items: FIX (frontend): In /app/frontend/app/auth.tsx, after `await login(...)` or `await register(...)` succeeds, call `router.replace('/(tabs)')` from expo-router. Alternative: at the top of AuthScreen, `const { user } = useAuth(); if (user) return <Redirect href='/(tabs)'/>;`

FIX (backend/env): EMERGENT_LLM_KEY has exceeded budget (Max budget: 0.0). Provision a working key or increase budget so /api/chat works. Also confirm model identifier 'claude-sonnet-5' is valid in emergentintegrations (may need e.g. 'claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929' or similar).
RETEST after fixes: full authenticated frontend flow (home hero, recipe navigation, category chips filter, share recipe form, profile tabs, logout, chat).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_recipes has unused `user` param in signature; remove for clarity.
auth.tsx lacks navigation on success — biggest UX blocker.
Google Auth flow was not exercised (requires real Emergent redirect); testIDs verified present.

success_rate.frontend: auth screen renders OK; post-login flow blocked (0% of authenticated flows testable)

seed_data_creation: Registered test user test.baker@bakers.app / TestBaker2026! via API. Created one TEST_Recette recipe attributed to that user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Main issue is the missing redirect in app/auth.tsx after successful auth. Once fixed, next iteration should run full E2E: login -> home (hero, tips carousel) -> Recettes tab (category chips filter) -> recipe detail (segmented tabs) -> Assistant chat (needs working EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) -> Share form -> Profile (Mes recettes / Sauvegardées) -> Logout. Use test.baker@bakers.app / TestBaker2026! (already registered).
rca_of_issue: 1) Chat 500: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget exhausted per backend log 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0'. 2) Auth redirect miss: app/auth.tsx submit() calls login/register which update user in AuthContext, but the component does not observe user or call router.replace. app/index.tsx redirects based on user, but the user is already on /auth so no re-mount occurs. Fix: add Redirect guard or router.replace after success.
